patthana23.24:1.1: Nasavitakkasavicāraṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā savitakkasavicāro kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā pannarasa.
patthana23.24:2.1: Nasavitakkasavicāraṃ naakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā savitakkasavicāro akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā nava.
patthana23.24:3.1: Nasavitakkasavicāraṃ naabyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā satta.
